# Tutorial - User Guide { #tutorial-user-guide }

This tutorial shows you how to use **FastAPI** with most of its features, step by step.

## Run the code { #run-the-code }

All the code blocks can be copied and used directly. Continue with [First Steps](first-steps.md), then [Query Parameters](query-params.md) and [Path Parameters](path-params.md).

/// tip

Each section builds on the previous ones, but it is structured to separate topics, so that you can go directly to any specific one.
